request_notes: Kubernetes create/update operations with text/plain accept complete UTF-8 manifest files; manifests are not wrapped in a textPlainDataString object. Node-pool repair preserves the top-level JSON node-name array.
Anonymous URI slots are resolved from named resource segments and path parameters; matching concrete request URLs supply examples.
Temporary kubeconfig generation is a confirmed non-retryable GET mutation. Cluster pricing is a stateless POST query.

notes: Current cluster list documents bizState but its captured response omits it; clusterStatus is deprecated. No readiness waiter silently substitutes that deprecated field.
Task, node-pool, template and specification-change task status fields lack documented terminal enums; example-only values are not used as readiness evidence.
Kubernetes proxy responses return manifest strings inside returnObj. The existing waiter model does not decode embedded YAML, so resource readiness cannot be inferred from the outer 800 envelope.
Upgrade-check completed means the check finished, not that every individual check passed.
Public node image query publishes only a statusCode 500 example value and no valid response example, so its successful response contract remains blocked.

Upgrade-check completion enums are documented, but all three examples contain ellipses instead of complete JSON. Waiter review cannot verify the response path against a captured example; completion waiters remain blocked.
